content:
olivia: quick heads-up — two racks from the EU shipment are stuck in customs (FK-3 and FK-4). estimated hold ~72h. raising because these were part of the Q2 reserved capacity for dedicated customers.
anya: thanks, @olivia. which datacenter are those racks destined for? rack IDs help us map to reservations.
olivia: FRA1. racks FK-3, FK-4 => will be in our FRA1 pool once cleared. paperwork submitted, but customs asked for additional compliance docs.
marcus: can you paste the customs request here or DM? we need to decide if we reassign other racks to cover the reservation shortfall.
olivia: pasted the note from broker: "require invoice with harmonized codes + proof of EORI" — we already have EORI but invoice needs line-item shipping HS codes. I'm updating finance.
samir: what's the impact on running deployments? if FRA1 capacity drops by 8 GPUs, can we failover some traffic to SIN1 or use spare H100s in dedicated-pool-b? avoids SLA hits.
anya: current reservation tracker: FRA1 had 2 reserved nodes for high-priority tenants (resv-211, resv-219) that were to be filled by FK-3/4. infra can temporarily move resv-219 to dedicated-pool-b (SIN1) but resv-211 has strict data locality flag.
lia: also note firmware schedule: FRA1 has a maintenance window tonight 23:00-02:00 CET for BMC update. If those racks clear customs post-approval, we risk window conflict for burn-in. we should avoid provisioning during or immediately after firmware work.
kapil: action items — (1) @olivia keep customs thread updated with expected clearance ETA, (2) @anya identify which reservations can be flexed to other regions by EOD, (3) @marcus check whether customers with data-locality are ok with temporary degraded throughput, (4) @samir validate model shard relocation costs. I'll coordinate comms to affected customers.
anya: quick checklist from infra side:
- tag FK-3/FK-4 as "pending-clearance" in inventory DB
- mark reservations resv-219 as "moved-provisional" if deployed to SIN1
- block automated provisioning jobs for FRA1 until clearance flag removed
I can do those now.
olivia: thanks — please hold automation. I'll update when broker confirms clearance.
marcus: FYI I pushed a tiny change to the reservation API to allow region-fallback flag: PR #1423. @anya can you review? it's needed if we programmatically shift reservations cross-region.
anya: noted. will review in the next hour. if approved, infra can flip the fallback bit for resv-219.
samir: if we end up routing models cross-region, cost estimator shows +12% egress and ~50ms added p90 latency for affected endpoints. need signoff from product or customer.
kapil: cc product leads, but we're ok to proceed if customer tolerance matches contract. I'll draft a single-sentence customer note.
lia: deploy-bot: capacity-reservations updated: resv-219 -> provisional SIN1 (note: pending PR #1423). :gear:
deploy-bot: notice: firmware-window tonight FRA1 23:00-02:00 CET. blocking provisioning ops during window.
olivia: updating customs broker now. I'll post ETA when available (aiming for 36h). will also ask them to fast-track invoices.
marcus: thanks everyone. next sync only if customs ETA slips past 48h. otherwise infra + deploy-bot action items cover this. :thumbsup:
kapil: I'll add a one-line milestone update to the Q2 board: "FRA1 shipment at customs; fallback plan in motion."
anya: done tagging and provisional move. comments in tracker: https://internal/rsv-tracker#resv-219
olivia: update 40m later — broker confirms expedited review, new ETA ~20h. I'll ping again when cleared.
marcus: great, closing this thread unless anything else pops up.
